warning: Grouped authoring requirements, not claims that every named shared owner is absent. No engine fixes or gameplay proof in this pass.

groups.required_boundary: Own exact once-only class/subclass/species/background/feat grants at class versus character thresholds, including full secondary-class features; preserve legacy saves.
Legal parameterized picks, replacements, prerequisite dependency checks, repeated instances and source ownership; reuse delivered class tool/skill and Skilled paths.
Class/list/ability/book/free-use/slot/preparation permissions and exact captured cast edits across actual eligible spell payloads. Spell candidates own spell behavior.
Exact source pool, capacity, recovery, fixed/rolled exchange, refund and payment timing; preserve separate class Channel Divinity and ordinary/Pact/created slots.
Exact attack/check/save/initiative/damage dice windows and settlement; thresholds, substitution, selected rerolls, damage replacement and once-per-turn limits.
Qualifying weapon/Unarmed/pact/Light attacks, substitutions, damage riders, critical thresholds and nonstacking attack counts.
Legal selected base AC, training/equipment conditions, source-owned speeds/HP and refresh at real grant and equipment boundaries.
Capture exact grant/recipient/item identity, duration/upkeep, triggers and early endings; propagate cleanup without global definition edits.
Reuse delivered condition spine; author selected saves, suppression/ending exceptions, exact source and recipient, and actual compelled behavior.
Legal displacement, climb/swim/fly/jump, size/space checks, post-hit granted moves and Opportunity Attack policy; execute in actual hosts.
Full legal forms, retained stats/equipment, owned actors, arrival, command/Reaction budgets, source lifetime and exploration hosts; existing curated form lists are not complete source sets.
Exact attack/damage/fall event, eligible owner, optional resource spend, reduction then redirection and legal off-turn choice; no blanket native-handler equivalence.
Slow Fall must reduce real falling damage at its legal Reaction window; not just store a passive modifier.
Execute actual permitted actions with correct action/Bonus Action/Reaction substitution and costs; Action Surge excludes Magic.
Known languages, Common+two standard choices, class secret/extra languages and actual messages; reuse OA local speech, do not invent world answers.
Represented observer senses, illumination, information, disguise/illusion, rest/time and object/trap interactions; declare unavailable facts/outcomes explicitly.
Exact equipment copies and quantities, linked tool/equipment choices, topics, hands/properties/weight, pact bonds and timed clockwork objects; do not substitute unknown items.
Actual chosen recipients, area and healing allocation with Bloodied/half-maximum eligibility; shared dice versus separately rolled healing remain explicit.

groups.slices: unassigned generic initiative exchange; S-233 acquisition reuse
groups.required_boundary: Alert: after-roll willing-ally initiative swap in same combat, neither Incapacitated; immediate exact values and order, no arbitrary late exchange.
